incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-042 resolved at 2026-03-10T14:12:03Z. Paging summary and timeline posted. Postmortem required per policy.

Alex Chen: ok team — we need to schedule the postmortem for INC-2026-042. Who can facilitate? thinking 45m max. @Priya any chance you can take lead?

Priya Patel: I can facilitate but will be OOO Wed afternoon. happy to do Mon/Tue. I can draft the timeline and run the RCA stickies.

Mateo Ruiz: CS ask: please include a short customer-impact section + list of affected customers. I can prep that if we lock time.

Samira Khan: I'd prefer co-facilitator so we can split probing and action assignment. Jordan are you available to co-facilitate?

Jordan Lee: can do co-facilitate Tue morning PT. Mon is tight for me.

Alex Chen: cool. propose options — react with :one: :two: :three: for availability and :wave: if you can facilitate.

Alex Chen: Option 1 — Mon 2026-03-15 10:00 PT (45m) :one:
Option 2 — Tue 2026-03-16 09:00 PT (45m) :two:
Option 3 — Wed 2026-03-17 16:00 CET (45m) :three:

Priya Patel: :one: :two: — both ok for me. :wave:

Jordan Lee: :two: :wave:

Samira Khan: :two: :three:

Mateo Ruiz: :two: (need to move things around but will be there)

incident-bot: Reminder: include required attendees: oncall, eng-sre rotation, product PM, CS, support engineer, and incident author. Suggested duration: 45 minutes.

Alex Chen: Attendees we need: me (oncall), Priya (SRE), Jordan (SRE), Samira (infra), @Mateo (CS), @Support (support rep), @Product_PM (product). Any other names to add?

Samira Khan: Add @security if there were any auth-related findings — but looks like infra config + flaky cache eviction so probably not required.

Priya Patel: Draft agenda (will paste into calendar invite):

```
1) Quick timeline and customer impact (5 min)
2) Root cause analysis and contributing factors (15 min)
3) Mitigations applied and why we picked them (5 min)
4) Action items, owners, and deadlines (15 min)
5) Follow-ups and monitoring changes (5 min)
```

Priya Patel: I'll drive sections 1-3, Jordan can take 4-5 with Samira. Mateo will present the customer-impact bullets.

Alex Chen: Looks good. Who will create the calendar invite? I can if someone confirms the final time.

Mateo Ruiz: please include link to the customer impact doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/CS/INC-2026-042-impact (I'll update with affected orgs + cadence notes)

Samira Khan: Quick note: please run the postmortem in this channel first and then copy notes to the official incident doc in the incidents wiki.

Priya Patel: I'm happy to create the invite if we lock on Option 2. Will set to Tue 2026-03-16 09:00 PT / 12:00 ET / 17:00 CET and add video link + agenda + RFC template.

Jordan Lee: confirmed. I'll add co-facilitator tag in the invite and put the RCA section in the doc beforehand so we don't waste time.

Alex Chen: Action items pre-meeting:
- Mateo: customer impact summary + affected customers (due Mon EOD)
- Priya: draft timeline + initial RCA notes (due Mon EOD)
- Jordan: collect logs and snapshot of cache config (due Mon EOD)
- Samira: quick infra remediation blurb + rollback plan if needed (due Mon EOD)
- Alex: create postmortem thread in incident tracker and link calendar invite (if Priya wants I can create it, but she volunteered)

Priya Patel: I'll own the calendar invite and the postmortem doc draft. tagging owners in the doc.

support-bot: Support ticket list for INC-2026-042: #4521, #4523, #4527. CS rep assigned: Mateo Ruiz.

Mateo Ruiz: noted. will reach out to the top 3 affected customers before the postmortem and summarize any escalations.

Alex Chen: ok final check — facilitator = Priya, co-facilitator = Jordan, meeting = Option 2 Tue 2026-03-16 09:00 PT. If anyone strongly objects, speak now.

Samira Khan: all good from infra.

Jordan Lee: good.

Mateo Ruiz: good.

Alex Chen: Priya if you want the invite description copied here I can pin it after you send it. Also please add a list of pre-reads (logs, customer notes).

Priya Patel: will do. I'll post the invite + initial doc link here when done. Expect invite within 15m. :calendar:

incident-bot: Postmortem scheduled: INC-2026-042 postmortem — Tue 2026-03-16 09:00 PT. Facilitator: Priya Patel. Co-facilitator: Jordan Lee. Required attendees: Alex Chen, Priya Patel, Jordan Lee, Samira Khan, Mateo Ruiz, Support rep.

Alex Chen: thanks everyone. after the meeting let's assign owners in the incident tracker and set SLAs for remediation tasks.

Priya Patel: invite sent + doc created: https://docs.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-042-postmortem. Pre-reads pinned.

Alex Chen: pinned. See you Tue.

Mateo Ruiz: thanks — I'll add customer notes by EOD Monday.

Samira Khan: I'll post the infra checklist to the doc as well.

Jordan Lee: I'll stub the action-item table so it's ready to be filled during the meeting.

Alex Chen: closing thread — prep reminders will go out 24h and 1h before the meeting. If anything changes re: attendance ping here. :thumbsup:
